findings.governingReading: なんだ、ほんとに is a broken realization continued by the narration that he seems genuinely tired; there is no stupid or rebuke.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s drowsy realization gains an unsupported insult.

findings.highlight: Every muscle and bone in my body is screwed.
findings.evidenceJa: 骨格という骨格が捩れている
findings.governingReading: 捩れている describes twisting, followed by grinding and rebellious bones.
findings.explanation: The twisting of every muscle and bone becomes an unspecific statement of bodily damage.

findings.evidenceJa: 体はより大きく膨張するという矛盾
findings.governingReading: The contradiction is compression into a smaller space while the body expands larger; the previous sentence locates the pain inside.
findings.explanation: Internal bodily expansion against compression becomes being pulled apart.
